trans-unit.target: The runner starts an agent on a step; it works on the card through the site's MCP endpoint and asks on it what it misses.
A card is one thing to do in a space: a title first, its steps and its day then.
A credit follows a paid service's balance, on the dashboard.
A machine runs the actions the steps of the cards name, for the spaces it serves.
A card's number names it to an agent, which reads it by that number.
A step naming an action runs on a machine, then the feedback is handed to it.
The dashboard search finds a card by its words, even a done one; Donovan answers a question from the cards and files you see.
The dashboard search finds a card by its words, even a done one.
A space gathers the cards of one project, shared between its members.
The steps are ticked one after the other, the feedback noted after them.
A plan template gives a card its steps at once, in the spaces that offer it.
Its steps say the work to do, some naming an action for a machine.
What it misses, it asks on the card: answer there, then hand the answer to the machine.
Spaces, cards and their steps, shared by people and agents.
The runner of a machine serving the space starts the agent on it.
The space of the project, in the left column.
It ticks each step it finishes and comments what it did.
The + of a tab adds a card to that collection.
The dashboard: the late cards, then the coming days.
Click the space the card belongs to, in the left column.
One line makes one card; a pasted list makes one card per line.
The key of your account on that service, kept encrypted and never shown again; left empty, the one saved stays. Expo also needs the account's name.
The piloting's name, top left, leads back to it.
The credit joins the top of the dashboard.
Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; the one a step's cost names.
The name the dashboard shows: « Hosting ».
A credit's border turns orange past half the month before its renewal, red in the last week if some is left; below, the later cards that could spend it, with what to do first.
A service read gives its balance through its API, with your account's key; empty, the balance is typed in by hand.
Reads the services read again at once; those typed in by hand are corrected in their box.
What is left; a service read replaces it at each reading.
Its token shows once: write it in secrets.yaml, in the pilot home of the machine.
The computer or the server it runs on: « workstation-1 ».
How many runs it takes at the same time, 1 by default.
It takes only the cards of the spaces ticked here.
Its tile shows its number; a click on it opens the card over the page.
A click on the number, above the title, copies it, ready to paste for an agent.
The dashboard: the late cards, then the coming days.
Click the space of the card, in the left column.

Click a step's text: its line names the machine action and its parameters, typed name=value; name=value; on a card laid from a template, a template step is changed on the template and only ticked here.
A card one of whose steps names a machine action.
After the run, the open feedback goes back to the machine, which ticks what it handled.
The dashboard: the runs under way first.
The ▶ button bears the action's name; it waits until the steps it depends on are ticked.
Click the space of the card, in the left column.
The Donovan button at the top of the column, or Ctrl+K on any page, opens its panel on the right: it answers in a few sentences from the cards and files you see, with their links.
The dashboard carries the search at the top of the page.
A few words or a question: the cards holding them, even done, show below as you type.
Its cards are tinted with it, so that each space is told at a glance.
It appears in the column of the spaces, ready for its first cards and members.
The name shown in the column of the spaces: « Catalog ».
The form a new space starts from, opened from the + beside the spaces.
The last word of the space's address, in lowercase letters, figures and dashes: « catalog ».
A click on its tile opens it over the page.
A fix or an idea after the steps, up to three screenshots pasted on the field if needed; those already ticked at the top fold under one heading.
When the steps form several groups, one click folds those entirely ticked, leaving open those still to do, and another unfolds them all.
The dashboard: the late cards, then the coming days.
Click the space of the card, in the left column.

One line per step; a step can name a machine action, launched by its button, and the values it asks, by a click on its text; no action leaves from anywhere else. On a card following a template, the steps come from the template.
The ticked spaces offer it as soon as it is saved.
The name the spaces' page shows: « Release ».
Among the settings, the plan templates.
The page of the ticked spaces offers this template.
One line per step, removed or moved in place.
The balance could not be read: check the API key and the account, the reason is in the log.
Machine added. Its token, shown this once only: %token%
A card holds %max% steps and comments at most.
A comment holds %max% screenshots at most.
No open comment to hand to the machine.
This run is no longer held by this machine.
This gesture does not apply to this card now.
This card's steps come from its template: add them to the template.
Share with the AI: copies the step and its card
Here is a card from my piloting, in markdown below. What I hand you: “%step%”. Let's discuss it before implementing.
%name% could not answer, try again later.
No card nor file seems to mention it.
Your question, for instance: what was decided for the backup?
Picture refused: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF of 10 MB at most
Drop a card here to move it to this space
A card of a plan stays in its plan's space.
The card could not be opened, try again.
The last collection of a space holding cards cannot be deleted
Double-click to rename, drag to move
Do you really want to delete?

## Closed
- Choose the theme colours
## Late
- Renew the domain name
## Coming
- Write the home page - Put the contact form online
The cards closed this week, the late ones and the coming days.
The done cards could not be loaded: close and open again to retry.
The new date of the card could not be saved.
Too long for this pass, %count% comments will go with the next one
The form expired, reload the page.

Find a card or ask Donovan

Service read or typed in by hand
Hand the feedback to the machine
The cards and page of these spaces offer this action.
The actions the machines can run, as they declare them. Choose on which spaces each one is offered.
%name% answers from the cards and files you see, with links to the ones it read.
The card, its runs and the files they kept are deleted; there is no way back.
New card, Enter to add it
Description in markdown: headings, lists, links, boxes to tick
One title per line, %max% at most; a title the space already holds is left aside.
The collection is deleted, its cards stay in the space.
Its cards show as tiles with a picture, without steps nor state (characters, places, apps)
The name of the account read, for a service whose key opens several (the Expo account).
Your account's key on this service (an access token for Expo), kept encrypted. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; the one a step's cost names.
What the planned steps may spend in a month, compared on the dashboard (empty: no budget)

The service whose API gives the balance, read again every morning, after a run spent on it and by « Refresh the balances », with your account's key; empty, the balance is typed in on the dashboard and a run takes off what it spent.
The balances of the paid services, shown on the dashboard: a service with an API read with your account's key, the others typed in on the dashboard then lowered by what the runs spend.
The reference is deleted permanently, the cards citing it stay, without a reference.
A fix or an idea; up to three screenshots are pasted here
The machine takes the card's last action again, doing only what the open comments ask, ticks those it handled and says why it leaves the others
How many runs the machine carries out at once, as much as it bears. An action marked exclusive in its actions.yaml always runs alone.
The spaces whose cards it takes, reports it fills and files it writes; none chosen, it serves every space.
The computers running the runner. A machine added gets its token once, to copy into the runner configuration.

The accounts of the site working in this space. A guest sees and ticks the cards given to it, a contributor works on every card, an editor also launches the machines, an owner sets the space up and chooses its members.
The piloting of every space: the dashboard, the search and the page of each space.
Its objectives, its cards (the dated ones first), its references and its done cards.
Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; used in the address of the space page.
The piloting spaces: their name, colour, sites and place in the column.
No online machine serves this space with this action: the step waits for a runner to declare it and connect.
Find a card, even a done one.
Numbers of the steps to tick before this one can be launched, separated by commas; empty: the previous step; « - »: none.
The line and its screenshots are deleted, with no way back.
Steps of one group follow each other and fold together on the card (Book, Film…). Empty: in no group.
A step it needs was redone after these files, they will be replaced
Template step: it is changed on the template
The page of these spaces offers this template.
A reusable series of steps, each done by hand or by a machine. A {name} in a title or a parameter is asked when the plan is created, on the page of the chosen spaces.
Late cards, then the coming deadlines: day by day over the next days, then month by month.
If an account of the site has the email %email%, it is now a member of the space.
No member yet: only the admin works here.
